Botan Rooftop Bar
Oct 2026 • Couples
My wife and I visited Hanoi for our 2nd wedding anniversary. We had no idea it was the Liberation Day celebration for Hanoi and we had a great time at the rooftop bar of the Meritel hotel: Botan. The staff was great and our assigned staff member, Binh, was wonderful. Very attentive and the drink selection was great! The staff was very helpful in offering recommendations for visiting Hanoi. We recommend staff at this hotel and having a drink at their bar!
